ns2:section.sectionText: Examines social crises in relationship to libraries and librarianship. Explores library services, programs and collections designed to mitigate the negative impact of each crisis, and maximize assistance for the involved communities. Current and evolving roles of information professionals and libraries in crisis management, preparedness, and response will be studied, as will information flow and the impact of technology. Graduate student questions may be sent to ischool-advising@illinois.edu
